name: Portugal
title: Holidays in Portugal
intro: Islands, beaches, hills and pastéis de nata. Here's where to go on holiday in Portugal, how long to stay and the best time to visit.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Portugal?
faqs.answer: Spring and early autumn are best for most of Portugal, from April to June and in September.

faqs.question: Where in Portugal is good for nature?
faqs.answer: Madeira and the Azores have walks, waterfalls and whale watching, and stay mild for most of the year.

faqs.question: Should we go to Lisbon or Porto?
faqs.answer: Both are great for a short break. Lisbon has beaches nearby, and Porto is smaller and easy to see in a long weekend.
